item.description: UnboundLocalError: local variable 'param_type' referenced before assignment in Parameter.validate() method due to variable scoping issue where param_type is used after being conditionally assigned.
item.contract: Fix the variable scoping issue in the Parameter.validate() method so that param_type is properly initialized before being referenced in conditional checks for non-string and non-number property validations.

item.description: RDS DBInstance validation incorrectly enforces credential requirements when DBSnapshotIdentifier is provided, causing test failures for valid configurations that should pass.
item.contract: Modify the DBInstance.validate() method to properly handle cases where DBSnapshotIdentifier is provided, allowing the validation to skip credential requirements in that scenario while still enforcing other constraints.

item.description: RDS DBInstance validation produces incorrect error message text that doesn't match expected test assertions, specifically regarding ManageMasterUserPassword vs MasterUserPassword validation.
item.contract: Update the error message in DBInstance.validate() to match the expected format exactly: "Either (MasterUsername and either MasterUserPassword or ManageMasterUserPassword) or DBSnapshotIdentifier are required in type AWS::RDS::DBInstance."
